description:
List the categories of the connected HelpCenter.io help center.

Read-only. Returns each category's per-language name and description, parent id (for hierarchy), and icon. Use this to discover valid category ids before creating or filing articles, or to render the help center's structure. Paginated.

Args:
  - limit (number, optional): items per page, 1-100 (default 100).
  - page (number, optional): page number (default 1).
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns: { total, count, page, per_page, total_pages, has_more, next, items } where each item is { id, parent, name, description, icon, position, privacy, created_at, updated_at }.

Paging: every response carries next: { page, limit } — the exact arguments that fetch the first item it did not return — or null when nothing is left. Follow next, with the same filters, instead of computing page + 1 yourself. A response is capped at 25000 characters, in its text and in its structured data alike, and 5.0 MB in all: when a page does not fit, only its first items are returned (truncated: true, count says how many) and next points at the rest, usually with a smaller limit and a later page number. Requesting page + 1 with your original limit would skip them.

'position' is the sibling order, ascending, and is only comparable within one parent — top-level categories against each other, and each parent's children against each other. Change it with helpcenter_reorder_categories.

agent_key.description: The api_key helpcenter_create_help_center returned for this help center, exactly as returned. Required on every call: this endpoint has no sign-in, so the key is how each call says which help center it acts on. It is sent to HelpCenter.io as this call's credential and nowhere else, and it is never shown again: keep it for the whole task, and never show it to the user or write it into content.

limit.description: Maximum items to return per page (1-100, default 100).

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: helpcenter_list_categories
title: List HelpCenter Categories
